title: Insta360 AI Hardware Teams Up with Alibaba Qianwen: Go Ultra Pocket Camera First to Integrate Voice Assistant Kira
excerpt: Insta360 is accelerating the integration of AI into its hardware, with the core action being the addition of an AI voice assistant to its product lineup. Accord
content_html:
Insta360 is accelerating the integration of AI into its hardware, with the core action being the addition of an AI voice assistant to its product lineup. According to media reports, this capability will first be applied to the Go Ultra series pocket camera, and it's quite "regionally sensitive": Google Gemini is used in China's Hong Kong, Macau, and overseas regions, while the Alibaba Qwen large model is integrated in mainland China. The translated results can be directly announced through the device's speaker.

The collaboration follows a "self-developed + integration with big tech models" approach. According to insiders, the AI voice assistant is primarily self-developed by Insta360, combined with the multimodal model capabilities of Alibaba Qwen. The division of labor is clear: voiceprint recognition and intent judgment are completed on the edge side, while complex tasks such as answering questions, mode switching, and translation are handled in the cloud, all managed by the internal project code-named Kira.

The Insta360 GO Ultra pocket camera was released in August last year, with a standard set price of 2598 yuan. On July 31, the official announced that the Go Ultra would receive a major update on August 5. From the poster information, "voice assistant Kira" is likely to be the main highlight of this release.

content_html_zh:
Insta360正在加速AI与硬件的融合，其核心动作就是在产品阵容中加入AI语音助手。 据媒体报道，这一能力将首先应用在Go Ultra系列袖珍相机上，而且相当“区域敏感”：谷歌Gemini在中国香港、澳门和海外地区使用，而阿里巴巴Qwen大型机型则在中国大陆集成。 翻译结果可以通过设备的扬声器直接宣布。

此次合作遵循“自主研发+与大科技模式融合”的方式。 据业内人士介绍，该AI语音助手主要由Insta360自主研发，结合阿里巴巴Qwen的多模态模型能力。 分工明确：声纹识别和意图判断在边缘侧完成，而回答问题、模式切换、翻译等复杂任务则在云端处理，全部由代号为 Kira 的内部项目管理。

Insta360 GO Ultra袖珍相机于去年8月发布，标准套装售价2598元。 7月31日，官方宣布Go Ultra将于8月5日迎来重大更新。 从海报信息来看，“语音助手Kira”很可能是本次发布的主要亮点。
